Folks — reviewed the materials. Finance position below: 

1) Net-75 materially increases DSO for this deal (projected $420k ACV). We generally do not approve beyond Net-60 without a mitigating control.
2) Proposed mitigations that Finance will accept: 
   - A purchase guarantee clause in the contract for the first 12 months (minimum spend), OR
   - Net-75 with an invoice financing fee of 0.75% per 30 days beyond Net-30 (transparent charge on invoice), OR
   - Net-45 + 1% early-pay discount for payments within 15 days.
3) Consolidated quarterly invoicing is operationally OK (we can issue a single invoice per calendar quarter) but need clear remittance instructions in the SOW.

Given the strategic upsell and the 24-month commitment, I’m willing to green-light Net-75 if Sales accepts the financing fee option and Legal signs the purchase guarantee. If Sales prefers no fee, escalate to Marissa for exec exception.

Please confirm which option you want applied so Finance can document it and include in the contract routing.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP Finance, Redwood Inference

APPROVED with conditions — Exec decision: approve Net-75 for CobbleTech, conditional on the following being added to the SOW/PO: 

1) Minimum first-year committed spend of $300k (matches renewal considerations).
2) A transparent financing fee of 0.5% per 30 days on amounts unpaid beyond Net-30 (applies only to invoices under the Net-75 concession).
3) Legal to include a one-sentence clause allowing Redwood to pause provisioning if invoices are >120 days overdue.
4) Consolidated quarterly invoices issued on calendar quarter boundaries with payment due Net-75 from invoice date.

Rationale: Strategic expansion potential justified the concession; the financing fee and minimum guarantee mitigate cash risk while keeping the deal competitive. Please proceed with contract redlines and obtain DocuSign. I am comfortable signing the exec exception memo once Legal adds the clauses.
